dialogues.speaker: Tiepolo
dialogues.text: Petrichor is a romantic, idyllic place. People respect custom and are customarily polite and friendly to outside guests.

dialogues.speaker: Tiepolo
dialogues.text: Of course, some of us go a little overboard, and as a result may seem almost... wary, perhaps.

dialogues.speaker: Tiepolo
dialogues.text: But do forgive us. Petrichor is far from the Court of Fontaine, and people here have hardly ever left the town.

dialogues.speaker: Tiepolo
dialogues.text: Just as a stone thrown into an ancient well can stir up ripples, people always fear that outlanders may disturb our peace.

dialogues.speaker: Tiepolo
dialogues.text: So please, do not hold it against them!
